entry.title: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
entry.summary: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue topped 100 trillion won for the first time, and the chipmaker says memory demand will outrun supply through 2030, with DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029.

entry.title: AI Security Startup Upwind Raises $400M at $3.8B Valuation
entry.summary: The cloud and AI security firm Upwind says revenue quadrupled in 2026 as it targets risks from autonomous AI agents.

entry.title: More Americans Have Tried Crypto, But Few Are Sticking With It: Survey
entry.summary: A survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund found that 22% of Americans have ever owned or used crypto, up from 18%, while past-year use held flat at 13%.

entry.title: OpenAI Plans to Buy Google's AI Chips as It Looks Beyond Nvidia: Report
entry.summary: OpenAI, one of Nvidia's biggest customers, reportedly plans to buy Google's TPU chips. Neither company has confirmed the report, and the price and size of the order were not disclosed.

entry.title: Fed Stands Pat, Bitcoin Holds Steady—But a December Rate Hike Is in Play
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

entry.title: AI Can Quietly Influence Experts’ Decisions, Anthropic Study Finds
entry.summary: Professional analysts went along with their AI agent’s hidden opinion 86% of the time, and few credited it.

entry.title: Strategy Shareholders Approve Daily Dividends on Preferred Stock, With 99.3% in Favor
entry.summary: STRC will begin paying dividends for every calendar day from November, with STRF, STRK and STRD following in January.

entry.title: Aptos Advisor Leaves Post, Moves Meme-Fueled Campaign to Meta Stock
entry.summary: Former Aptos advisor "Buzz” has left the crypto project and is turning his attention to Facebook's parent company Meta—here's why.

entry.title: Wall Street’s Fast Money Fled Bitcoin ETFs, Sovereign Funds Stepped In
entry.summary: Galaxy Research found that nine hedge funds and banks cut 68,000 BTC worth of spot ETF exposure as the cash-and-carry trade dried up, while wealth platforms and sovereign funds added.

entry.title: Fed Rate Decision: What Markets and Bitcoin Traders Can Expect
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve decides today at 2 p.m. ET and traders see a hold as near certain. Here's what it means for Bitcoin and stock markets.

entry.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola Among 7 More Companies Objecting to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stocks
entry.summary: Seven more companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola and Dell, have objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 33.

entry.title: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
entry.summary: James Comer warned the proposed "AIC" could shield AI firms from liability, and asked Delaware's governor for documents by November 9.

entry.title: Goldman, BlackRock Alumni Raise $4 Million to Put Farm and Apartment Loans Onchain
entry.summary: Birch Hill, founded by Goldman Sachs and BlackRock alumni, raised $4 million in a seed round led by Multicoin Capital to build a regulated path for bringing U.S. loans onchain.

entry.title: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
entry.summary: The ratings agency cited RLUSD's Treasury-heavy reserves, but noted that holders have no direct ownership interest in them for now.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Robinhood Misses, But Crypto Beats and Robinhood Chain Soars
entry.summary: Vlad Tenev delivered the messaging that Robinhood Chain enthusiasts wanted to hear—and the market responded.

entry.title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data
entry.summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange is checking whether customer data was exposed, as two other financial firms report breaches.

entry.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
entry.summary: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

entry.title: China's Stock Market Has Lost $2.4 Trillion as Investors Doubt Its AI Boom Will Ever Pay Off
entry.summary: Stocks on China's mainland have shed about $2.4 trillion since May as investors doubt AI companies can turn a profit, while U.S. restrictions and high U.S. interest rates add pressure.

entry.title: Robinhood Misses Q3 Earnings as Crypto Revenue Rises and Prediction Market Bets Grow
entry.summary: Robinhood posted record revenue of $1.42 billion but earned $0.51 per share, short of the $0.55 expected, as bets on sports and elections grew to $173 million and crypto edged up.

entry.title: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
entry.summary: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and heads to the Robinhood app later this year as the companies deepen ties in treasury and institutional trading.

entry.title: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
entry.summary: An expanded deal with Bitso puts Anchorage Digital Bank’s custody beneath both sides of the US-Mexico remittance route.

entry.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
entry.summary: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.

entry.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
entry.summary: Intel, Oracle, IBM, and IonQ became the latest companies to object to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 26.

entry.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
entry.summary: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

entry.title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
entry.summary: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.

entry.title: A $3M Hedge, a Midterm Test and Retail's Rise: Prediction Markets at NEXTPredict
entry.summary: Chuck Todd called markets a "fact checker" for journalism, as Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood pitched contracts well beyond elections.

entry.title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
entry.summary: A new OpenAI paper declares ETH false, a claim that hundreds of research papers lean on. Crypto Twitter degens and serious mathematicians are abuzz.

entry.title: McDonald's McRib Doesn't Actually Boost Bitcoin's Price, Sorry Everyone
entry.summary: Crypto traders think the McRib’s return to McDonald's means a Bitcoin pump is coming. Experts say there is "no correlation at all."

entry.title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
entry.summary: The firm's new head of investigations says its surveillance system flags hundreds of alerts a day, with at least two cases sent to the CFTC.

entry.title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale Its AI Compute Push
entry.summary: The CMT Digital-led round, which drew mining-hardware makers Canaan and MicroBT, will fund Luxor’s expansion into AI compute trading, hardware and derivatives.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Battle Looms Over Robinhood’s Earnings Call
entry.summary: One of crypto’s primary growth sectors for this upcoming cycle is under attack. Will Vlad Tenev speak up on today’s Robinhood earnings call?

entry.title: Why This Team of Ninjas Is Tripling Down on Mining Bitcoin
entry.summary: NIP Group says Bitcoin mining has “earned its place” as the esports giant swaps 247 million shares for more machines.

entry.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
entry.summary: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

entry.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
entry.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.
